text:
alex: seeing ~0.6-1.2% packet loss between pods on g9n across two racks in us-west-2, started ~07:12 UTC. traces show retransmits and high tail latency on east-west flows.

maria: thanks — is this isolated to tensorflow training jobs or general?

alex: both. batch and small-request traffic. only g9n so far, other instance types look fine.

jon: can you paste ethtool -S and dmesg tail? suspecting mlx5/firmware.

alex: pasted logs:
```
# ethtool -S eth0 | egrep "rx_err|tx_err|rx_no_buf|rx_discards"
rx_errors: 12345
tx_errors: 12
rx_no_buf: 0
rx_discards: 876
```
and dmesg snippets: 
```
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: Unhandled completion error, syndrome 0x4f
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: FW log: mcq err clr 0x2
```

infra-bot: alerted on NIC-errors >5% over 10m on cluster g9n-usw2-a, creating incident INC-20250602-7

sam: link flaps? interface shows up/down? ifplugstatus?

alex: interfaces stay up, no carrier drop, but RX/TX counters climb and packet-checksums fail intermittently. rdma pingpong shows failed QPs occasionally.

kyle: what firmware + driver versions? we rolled mlx5 fw 22.1.0 to this fleet last week. kernel is 5.15.0-88.

alex: fw 22.1.0, mlx5_core 5.15-1, libibverbs 52, rdma-core 29.1.

maria: we saw similar symptoms with fw 22.1.0 on c7 series earlier — fragmentation on large MTU and microbursts caused rx queue starvation. workarounds were: reduce MTU to 8950 or disable GRO/GSO.

jon: can we confirm MTU?

alex: MTU is 9000 on these nodes. tcpdump shows lots of ICMP frag-needed when we force path MTU probe.

sam: quick mitigation: set MTU 8950 on a canary node and toggle GRO off:
```
ip link set dev eth0 mtu 8950
ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off
```

kyle: trying on one canary now. rolling config out to 10% of instances. monitoring.

(15m later)

kyle: canary looks stable — rx_errors down from 12k -> 18 over 15m window, retransmits gone.

alex: nice. still need root cause. open a ticket with Mellanox/driver?

maria: next steps: collect firmware logs with mlx5_core logging enabled, capture tcpdump + vmcore if it crashes, and try fw 22.2.0 on staging (release notes mention fragmentation fixes).

jon: also add rdma repro test: iperf3 between pods with varying message sizes and burst patterns. include kernel perf traces.

ashley: flagged for infra release window — fw upgrade requires reboot so schedule during maintenance and coordinate Dedicated customers.

alex: created task INF-1942 with steps and rollback plan (mtu/gro toggle). attaching ethtool/dmesg dumps in the task.

infra-bot: update: incident INC-20250602-7 severity->warning, assigned to eng-infra oncall.

sam: TL;DR: observed mlx5 fw 22.1.0 + MTU 9000 => RX fragmentation/microburst stalls on g9n; canary mitigation MTU 8950 + disable GRO reduces errors. planned: test 22.2.0 on staging, schedule fw rollout with reboots and customer notice. :white_check_mark:
